notes: One function per environment action (recommended). Map tool name -> PathwayAction.action_type in the harness.
Call env reset() before the tool loop; reset is not an OpenAI tool.
Compatible with Chat Completions tools= and Responses API function tools (same shape).

function.name: understand_experiment_design
function.description: Summarize experimental groups (conditions, sample counts, default contrast). Optionally validate a DESeq2 contrast by providing reference (condition_a) and alternate (condition_b). Does not run differential expression. Provide both condition fields or neither.

condition_a.description: Reference / baseline condition name (denominator for log2FC). Must match a value in available_conditions.

condition_b.description: Alternate / comparison condition name. Must differ from condition_a.

function.name: inspect_dataset
function.description: Return sample IDs, per-sample condition metadata, and whether PyDESeq2 is available. Does not run DE or enrichment.

function.name: run_differential_expression
function.description: Run PyDESeq2 differential expression for reference vs alternate on the episode count matrix. Requires condition_a and condition_b unless a contrast was validated via understand_experiment_design or the case defines default_contrast.

function.name: run_pathway_enrichment
function.description: Run over-representation analysis (Fisher ORA) on DE genes against pathway gene sets in the case. In pipeline mode, run_differential_expression must succeed first.

gene_list.description: Optional explicit gene list for ORA. If omitted, uses significant DE genes from the last DE step per case analysis_options.

function.name: compare_pathways
function.description: Compare exclusive vs shared differential-expression gene support between two named pathways from the case pathway_genes.

pathway_a.description: First pathway name (exact string as in enrichment results or case pathway_genes keys).

function.name: submit_answer
function.description: Submit final hypothesis: the activated signaling pathway name. Ends the episode. String must match case pathway naming exactly (case-insensitive match on server).

unified_alternative.description: Single-tool variant that maps 1:1 to PathwayAction if you prefer one function with action_type enum.

function.name: pathway_env_step
function.description: Execute one step in the pathway analysis environment.
